scripts.all:del: bun presta:del && (cd selenium && bun sel:down) && (rm -rf scrapper-results)
scripts.all:setup: cp .env.example .env && bun all:deps && echo 'Setup complete. You can now start the PrestaShop environment.'
scripts.all:deps: bun presta:deps && (cd scrapper && bun deps) && (cd selenium && bun deps) && docker swarm init || echo 'Swarm already initialized'
scripts.presta:deps: cd prestashop/docker && docker compose --env-file ../../.env -f compose.dev.yaml pull && docker compose --env-file ../../.env -f compose.dev.yaml build
scripts.presta:up: cd prestashop/docker && docker compose --env-file ../../.env -f compose.dev.yaml up -d --build
scripts.presta:down: cd prestashop/docker && docker compose --env-file ../../.env -f compose.dev.yaml down
scripts.db:up: cd prestashop/docker && docker compose --env-file ../../.env -f compose.dev.yaml up -d db
scripts.db:del: cd prestashop/docker && docker compose --env-file ../../.env -f compose.dev.yaml down db -v
scripts.prod:db:up: cd prestashop/docker && docker compose --env-file ../../.env -f compose.prod.db.yaml up -d
scripts.prod:db:down: cd prestashop/docker && docker compose --env-file ../../.env -f compose.prod.db.yaml down
scripts.prod:db:del: cd prestashop/docker && docker compose --env-file ../../.env -f compose.prod.db.yaml down -v
scripts.prod:presta:up: cd prestashop/docker && docker compose --env-file ../../.env -f compose.prod.yaml up -d
scripts.prod:presta:down: cd prestashop/docker && docker compose --env-file ../../.env -f compose.prod.yaml down
scripts.prod:presta:del: cd prestashop/docker && docker compose --env-file ../../.env -f compose.prod.yaml down -v
scripts.presta:hack:theme: docker exec prestashop php bin/console prestashop:theme:enable custom_action && sleep 2 && docker exec prestashop bash -c "rm -rf var/cache/*"
scripts.swarm:db:up: source .env && export STACK_PREFIX && cd prestashop/docker && envsubst < compose.swarm.db.yaml | docker stack deploy -c - ${STACK_PREFIX}_db -d
scripts.swarm:up: source .env && export STACK_PREFIX && cd prestashop/docker && envsubst < compose.swarm.dev.yaml | docker stack deploy -c - ${STACK_PREFIX} -d
scripts.swarm:ls: docker stack ls && docker service ls
